question: Does an exact-location wall-conditioned cell profile predict a target local registered-cell rate-change vector in the next exposure after jointly adjusting 5 cm spatial rates for speed, allocentric movement direction, and session time?

design.spatial_estimator: 5 cm bin fixed effects estimated jointly with behavior by within-bin Frisch-Waugh-Lovell residualization
design.movement_direction_when_speed_below_thre: all movement-direction harmonics set to zero before standardization
design.common_physical_reference: initial familiar-square median speed, zero movement-direction harmonics, and normalized session time zero for every session
design.blocked_partition_handling: adjusted rates masked and analysis occupancy set to zero from authoritative blocked-partition metadata
design.target_adjustment: target-session neural outcomes estimate that session's nuisance coefficients before scoring; target rates never enter training profiles
design.predicted_object: one adjusted square-residual local strip rate per registered cell; not a full spatial map or global shape
design.behavior_control_scope: additive linear speed, movement-direction harmonics, and session time; no local interaction matching
design.matching_wall_predictor: mean adjusted edit from other shapes with the exact oriented physical seam walled
design.control_predictor: mean adjusted edit from other shapes with the same seam open
design.outcome: Spearman(target edit, wall template) minus Spearman(target edit, open template)
design.occupancy_support: test-aware common-bin eligibility; no neural values used

settings.map_orientation: released image-style row = floor(raw y / 5 cm)
settings.covariate_standardization: initial familiar-square mean and scale frozen for every later session
